start_here: Install Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+ and Git. Run python -B tools/dev.py from the repository root. jq 1.7.1 is optional for the jq test.

commands.windows_python_alias: Use py -3 in place of python if needed.
commands.mac_linux_python_alias: Use python3 in place of python if needed.

layout.tools: All build/translation tools, source templates and regression tests.
layout.scripts: Unified UTS/F1 and native Fitness Chinese-only runtimes; shared translation adapter is bundled into both content-addressed assets.
layout.loon: One unified plugin plus a compatibility alias at the former F1 experimental URL. Install only one.
layout.config/release.json: Version 2: own-repository runtime_base_url and subtitle_base_url. Static subtitles retain original commit/path identities under vendor/pinned; runtimes use full SHA-256 filenames.
layout.vendor/pinned: Exact upstream scripts: 118 active dependencies, 121 retained commit/path pairs. Loon loads these byte-identical resources from this repository; SHA-256 checked offline and on publication.
layout.vendor/pinned-manifest.json: Checksums for pinned sources. No separate clone of original Git history required.
layout.vendor/upstream-snapshot.json: Upstream source attribution, snapshot revision and checksums.
layout.payloads: Full upstream payload source snapshot; includes recorded real HLS master structure used in regression tests.
layout.subtitles: Published Chinese M3U8/VTT resources, not embedded in plugin.
layout.examples: Synthetic samples and nonfunctional .test domain config templates.
layout.tests/fixtures: Sanitized clear caption packets and timestamps only. No original media/headers/credentials.
layout.local/catalog.json: Empty custom program catalog; keep private material under ignored local/.
layout.build: Ignored generated base and release artifacts.

requirements.jq: optional; tests were run with jq 1.7.1
requirements.deepseek_key: Set only in Loon plugin arguments; not needed by offline tests.
requirements.translation_credentials: Choose deepseek (default) or volcengine in Loon. DeepSeek requires deepseek_key; Volcengine requires machine translation activation, volc_access_key_id and volc_secret_access_key. Fill secrets only in local Loon arguments; offline tests need none.

fitness_flow: Do not intercept play.itunes.apple.com. No Fitness master rewrite, independent Chinese track or single-course injection is used by the unified release.
Select English captions in Fitness+. Native hls-svod.itunes.apple.com English VTT cues show Chinese only after translation; failed or timed-out cues retain their own original English.
Native subtitle playlists, audio and video remain unchanged. Old marker URLs are accepted and old synthetic URLs immediately redirect to native resources.

Translation has a 2-15 second deadline (default 8), controlled by deepseek_wait for either provider. DeepSeek retains its versioned 128-slot segment cache; Volcengine uses a 512-slot bounded sentence cache and retains successful batches during partial failures.
f1_flow_and_limits: All F1 OnDemand subscription playback URLs on play/play-edge use native playback and locally registered program/asset IDs for native English WebVTT translation, regardless of qualifying/practice/race title. Condensed metadata remains supported. Register for four hours; do not modify signed playback/FairPlay or translate unrelated assets.

Registered native F1 English HLSSportsVodVideo WebVTT is translated by response body edits using f1_wait and existing providers/caches. Timing/maps/settings retained, failures retain English. Real Race in 30 format verified; qualifying actual format requires phone feedback. Old synthetic subscription bridge refreshes native registration then redirects to source.
One UTS JS dispatcher applies the pinned static catalog first, then registers remaining F1 OnDemand assets by league metadata. No parallel jq UTS rewrite.
Static movies, series, F1 replays and previews retain upstream routing. AI is generic for other F1 OnDemand assets with supported English CC1 CatchUp media.
Rewrite only hlsUrl to the hls-amt master bridge; retain FairPlay certificate, nonce and license URLs. Never intercept linear.tv.apple.com, play.itunes.apple.com or play-edge.itunes.apple.com.
Master GET has a four-second deadline and redirects to original playback on failure. Storage failure also prevents unusable track injection.
Read clear GA94 CEA-608 packets and sample timestamps without decrypting or modifying video. One low-bandwidth caption source per pathway; translation runs only on subtitle requests.
Reuse extracted fragments on duplicate requests. Bounded decoder snapshots are keyed by stream and media boundary time to avoid request-order state contamination across seeks.
Live streams, CEA-708-only content, no-English-CC content and unrecorded CDN formats are not supported by this release.

User confirmed working F1 subtitles and improved jumping behavior; remaining fallback causes are not confirmed from logs. Tests use reconstructed upstream multivariant structure, sanitized real CC packets and synthetic MP4 fragments.

20261124b coalesces adjacent CEA-608 character-prefix updates within a fragment. Exact normalized source sentences reuse one model-specific Chinese translation across fragments and pathways in 512 bounded slots.

Cached Chinese is retained when a new cue fails. Transient HTTP/network/format errors get at most one retry within f1_wait; 401/403 are not retried. Logs record fallback reason and cache counts without caption text or credentials.

Subtitle requests may retrieve one previous fragment with a 1.5 second deadline to reconstruct carried CC. Raw extracted caption frames are cached to repair an eager decode when predecessor state arrives later. Video never waits for translation.
Requests cannot guarantee Chinese when the translation service remains unavailable; only untranslated cues fall back to their own English text. Stability fixes still require phone confirmation.

20261124c adds independent optional f1_wait (default 15 seconds, range 2-15); existing deepseek_wait continues to control Fitness only. F1 request script limit is 22 seconds, including at most 3 seconds current-fragment fetch and 1.5 seconds previous-fragment repair.

Legacy positional translation arrays must have an exact cue count before mapping. New requests use explicit cue ids. Each valid Chinese result is cached immediately; only unresolved entries are retried. Unchanged ordinary English is not treated as success. A well-formed JSON object inside a markdown JSON code fence is accepted.

Before English fallback, recheck shared caches for Chinese saved by overlapping requests. Preserve validated v2 Chinese cache entries; reject v2 English masquerading as Chinese. A synchronous HTTP-client failure returns original captions instead of empty VTT.
A supplied 20261124c log confirms repeated translation-count mismatch for a two-cue request. Other fallback occurrences may have other causes.

20261124d requests translations as an id-keyed object using stable cN ids within each segment request. Accept valid matching ids independent of response order, salvage known ids in partial responses, and reject duplicate ids in indexed arrays. Legacy string arrays are mapped only when counts match exactly.

When a multi-cue response is structurally invalid or incomplete, recover unresolved cues as individual requests rather than repeating the same batch. At most six recovery calls, at most two concurrent, all sharing the original f1_wait deadline; no extra retry loop per recovered cue.

Do not split a merged translation heuristically or guess which time interval it belongs to. Invalid merged output is discarded; each original cue is recovered independently. Unknown response ids are ignored; successful mapped Chinese remains cached.
release_workflow: Edit tools/translation_service.js, tools/fitness_deepseek.js, tools/uts_static.js, tools/f1_cc608.js and tools/f1_cc_runtime.js as needed. Build prepends the shared adapter to both runtimes; static catalog comes from generate_loon.static_catalog().
Run python -B tools/build_release.py. Review build/ artifacts; copy current loon/ and scripts/ entries returned by build_release.release_files() into the matching repository paths.
Content-addressed runtime filenames include the full SHA-256. Never change the contents of an existing hashed filename. Both plugin URLs reference the same unified implementation.
Run python -B tools/dev.py, which includes build reproducibility, Python and JavaScript checks. --check-published compares local release files only; it does not confirm remote publication.
When publishing is authorized, upload all referenced hashed runtimes before updating plugin subscriptions. Verify remote bytes and URLs, then record real phone feedback in this JSON.

Install only one subscription alias. Disable/remove older enabled copies that still intercept play.itunes.apple.com. If other Loon configuration also decrypts that domain, remove that conflicting entry separately.
upstream_refresh: Get a separate full checkout of rexchen1803/apple-video-subtitles. It is a different repository/history; do not merge it blindly into this main branch.
Review and copy desired updated upstream payloads/client modules. Record the new upstream revision in vendor/upstream-snapshot.json.
Run python -B tools/bundle_upstream.py /path/to/upstream-checkout to refresh fixed-commit dependencies referenced by the current Surge module.
Review data shape changes reported by generator; rerun tests, rebuild and review the stable/experimental plugin diff before publishing.

Keep vendor/pinned and its manifest append-only so previous subscriptions and regression sources continue to work. Generated Loon script URLs use config/release.json subtitle_base_url; source Surge modules retain upstream provenance.
Publish and verify all mirrored scripts and new hashed runtimes in this repository before advancing either Loon subscription. No live subtitle script download should point at rexchen1803 or its CDN.

Keep GitHub free of Markdown; development handoff is JSON.

translation_services.selection: translation_provider: deepseek (default), volcengine. One manual selection applies to Fitness+ and F1. No automatic cross-provider fallback. Unknown provider or missing selected credentials fails closed to native playback/captions.
translation_services.volcengine_setup: Activate machine translation. Obtain permanent Access Key ID and Secret Access Key; subusers need translation permission (official setup guide documents TranslateFullAccess). Fill volc_access_key_id and volc_secret_access_key only in local Loon arguments.
translation_services.api: POST https://translate.volcengineapi.com/?Action=TranslateText&Version=2020-06-01; region cn-north-1; service translate; SourceLanguage en; TargetLanguage zh.
translation_services.runtime: tools/translation_service.js is bundled into both runtimes. Standalone UTF-8/SHA-256/HMAC signing has no Node/WebCrypto or network library dependency. Signing uses the exact serialized body sent to the server.
translation_services.batching: At most 16 texts / 5000 UTF-16 code units per request (conservative for supplementary characters), at most two requests in flight. Overlong single cues retain English. Each transient network/429/5xx or recognized transient API error gets at most one retry within the original shared deadline; 401/403, permanent API errors and malformed results do not retry.
translation_services.mapping: TranslationList must have exactly the requested count. Validate each aligned translation; never guess when count mismatches. Successful batches are cached immediately; failures and deadline preserve those results and retain English for unresolved cues. Late callbacks cannot write caches or finish again.
translation_services.caches: Provider, en-to-zh language pair and model/API version distinguish caches. Existing validated DeepSeek caches remain usable only by DeepSeek. No credentials, subtitle bodies, request headers or raw API responses are logged.
translation_services.waits: Fitness deepseek_wait default 8 seconds; F1 f1_wait default 15 seconds; both clamped to 2-15 seconds for either provider.
